title: Summary: Undoing Safely
objective: Unstage a change, print the status, discard the change, and print whether the folder is clean.
hint: Commit the README, Add-Content for Second section, git add, then git restore --staged README.md, and Write-Output with (git status --short). Then git restore README.md. Then if (-not (git status --short)) with Write-Output Status: clean inside it.
